effects: The signer sends msg.value CORE (native) to the Earn contract. It must be at least mintMinLimit (1 CORE by default).
Earn delegates that CORE to the chosen validator through PledgeAgent. Earn holds the delegation, not the signer.
The signer receives stCORE = msg.value * 1e6 / current exchange rate. Earn mints it to msg.sender.
formats.shown: "Stake CORE" with the native amount sent and the validator address.

findings.title: mint: the intent and fields never say the signer receives stCORE for the CORE staked
findings.evidence: Earn.sol mint: `uint256 stCore = _exchangeSTCore(amount); ISTCore(STCORE).mint(account, stCore);` Descriptor: intent "Stake CORE", fields only `@.value` and `_validator`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Stake CORE for stCORE". The stCORE amount comes from the exchange rate in storage, so no field can show it.

findings.title: mint: the validator field suggests a personal delegation, but Earn owns the stake
findings.evidence: Earn.sol _delegate: `IPledgeAgent(PLEDGE_AGENT).delegateCoin{value: amount}(validator); validatorDelegateMap.add(validator, amount);` Earn can rebalance this stake to other validators. Descriptor label "Validator Address".
findings.fix: Change the label to "Delegate via validator" or similar, so the signer sees that the pool holds the stake.

findings.title: mint: the stCORE amount received depends on a stored exchange rate the descriptor cannot show

effects: Earn burns stCore stCORE from the signer. It needs no approval, and the amount must be at least redeemMinLimit.
No CORE arrives now. Earn records a claim of stCore * rate - protocolFee CORE that unlocks after lockDay days (7 by default).
A protocol fee (protocolFeePoints of the CORE value) is cut from the claim and later goes to protocolFeeReceiver.
formats.shown: "Request Redeem" with the stCORE amount to redeem.

findings.title: redeem: the intent "Request Redeem" does not say stCORE is burned and CORE comes only after a lock
findings.evidence: Earn.sol redeem: `ISTCore(STCORE).burn(account, stCore);` and `unlockTime: block.timestamp + DAY_INTERVAL * lockDay`. Descriptor intent "Request Redeem".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Burn stCORE to request CORE (locked)". Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Redeem {stCore} for CORE after unlock".

findings.title: redeem: the CORE claim amount and the protocol fee come from storage and are not shown
findings.evidence: Earn.sol redeem: `uint256 core = _exchangeCore(stCore); uint256 protocolFee = core * protocolFeePoints / RATE_BASE; uint256 redeemAmount = core - protocolFee;`

effects: Earn removes every matured redeem record of the signer.
The signer receives the summed CORE (native) of those records. The protocol fees of those records go to protocolFeeReceiver.

findings.title: withdraw: the CORE amount comes from the signer's stored redeem records and cannot be shown
findings.evidence: Earn.sol withdraw: `if (record.unlockTime < block.timestamp) { accountAmount += record.amount; ... }` then `payable(account).sendValue(accountAmount);`

findings.title: withdraw: the intent does not say it claims only unlocked redemptions, all of them at once
findings.evidence: Earn.sol withdraw loops all records and pops each with `record.unlockTime < block.timestamp`. Descriptor intent "Withdraw CORE".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw unlocked CORE".

couldNotCheck: The stCORE token contract (STCORE, read from Earn storage) is not in the directory. Without it I cannot confirm that the descriptor's token 0xb3A8F0f0da9ffC65318aA39E55079796093029AD is the token that redeem burns from the signer and mint mints to the signer.

redeem(uint256 stCore).worst: redeem: the intent "Request Redeem" does not say stCORE is burned and CORE comes only after a lock
